key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Perennial in the Williamson County treatment; broader treatments note substantial variation.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Twining or trailing vine with a taproot and long lateral roots.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate; ovate-deltoid to shallowly 3-lobed, cordate at base; leaf shape variable.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Outer sepals about 8–11 mm, usually ciliate/hairy; inner sepals about 10–12 mm.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Pink to purple, usually about 2.5–4.5 cm, darker in the throat.

key_traits.label: Key
key_traits.text: Shorter, broader sepals than I. hederacea; perennial rooting habit also helps.
